scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && cross-env PORT=3001 npm start
scripts.start: node init && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && cross-env PORT=3001 npm start
scripts.build: node init && cd frontend && npm run build
